title: Confusion Matrix
signature: def confusion_matrix(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, num_classes: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Rows are the true class and columns are the predicted class: cm[t, p] counts samples with y_true = t and y_pred = p.
cm[y_true, y_pred] += 1 does NOT count repeated pairs. Buffered fancy assignment writes each index once.
Encode each pair as a single integer t * C + p, count with np.bincount(..., minlength=C*C), and reshape to (C, C). np.add.at also works.
